chapters: ParcelGuard · Reserve once. Recover safely from a lost acknowledgement.
1 / A new request commits inventory, order, cached response and outbox together.
2 / Repeating the same intent replays its response. Stock is reserved once.
3 / The consumer commits, then the acknowledgement is lost. One effect; work remains pending.
4 / Redelivery is acknowledged. The unique consumer event key suppresses a second local effect.
5 / Compare completion and attempts together. Latency includes successful clients only.
Independent local prototype · Synthetic retry model · Full source, tests and limitations in the repository.
scope: Uncut automated capture of the local Python app with an isolated temporary database.
